title: Schema-level HTTP connections in Unity Catalog are now generally available
body: HTTP connections in Unity Catalog are now generally available at the schema level. You can create an HTTP connection inside a schema instead of only at the metastore level. A schema-level connection uses the three-level namespace (`catalog.schema.connection`) and inherits Unity Catalog privileges from its parent schema, so you can apply the same access controls and auditing that you use for other data assets. Metastore-level HTTP connections remain in [Public Preview](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). See [Connect to external HTTP services](/aws/en/query-federation/http).
